Heard learned counsel for the accused-applicant as well as the learned Aga and perused the

. 
2. The present bail application under Section 438 Cr.P.C. has been filed seeking anticipatory bail in
Case Crime No.368 of 2020, under Sections 420, 467, 478 and 471 Ipc, Police Station Maudarwaja,
District Farrukhabad.
3.  An F.I.R. dated 27.8.2020 was lodged by one Ravikant, who is a Government Official alleging that certain consolidation records were prepared in a clandestine manner.
The F.I.R. was lodged against three persons, namely, Ram Shankar, Rajrani and Ramkali.
4. Learned counsel for the accused-applicant submits that the accused-applicant is innocent and he has been falsely implicated in the offence.

He further submits that the F.I.R. in question was Ram Shankar vs State Of U.P. on 21 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/75626039/
1 registered on 27.8.2020, but till date police has not collected any such information on the basis of which complicity of present accused-applicant can be said to be established in above mentioned case crime number.

entities.text: Ram Shankar vs State Of U.P.
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: He further submits that this Court after considering the entire facts and circumstances of the case, granted interim protection to the accused-applicant on 14.10.2020 and he has cooperated during the course of investigation and he has not misused the liberty granted to him and, therefore, the accused-applicant may be enlarged on anticipatory bail.
5. Learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer for anticipatory bail, but not disputed the aforesaid facts.
6. Considering the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case, this Court finds that the accused-applicant is entitled to be enlarged on anticipatory bail.
7. Accordingly, anticipatory bail application is allowed.
